messages:
Andrea (PM): Quick sync — I put up the PRD draft for the unified chat/completions + embeddings + rerank launch. link: https://redwood.docs/prd/chat-unified-draft
Michael (Eng): saw it, thanks. main ask: can we lock latency SLOs in the PRD? current language is vague — we should call out p50/p95 targets and batching expectations.
Sophia (ML PM): agreed. also need acceptance criteria for quality: what evals do we run for rerank delta and embedding similarity drift? I added TODOs in the doc.
Raj (SRE): FYI rollout concerns: dedicated vs hosted routing fallback needs an explicit rollback plan here. If dedicated pool is saturated, what auto-fallback policy do we apply? we should include circuit-breaker thresholds.
Andrea (PM): Good points. Proposal: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 350ms for small chat models on hosted. For rerank/embeddings we'll define throughput targets separately. I'll add those numbers but want engineering buy-in.
Michael (Eng): p50 80ms is fine for short-seq path if we enable continuous batching and kv-cache warm. p95 350ms is tight if we allow cold-starts — we should call out warm vs cold and maybe an SLO exception during canary.
Eve (Design): one UX note — acceptance criteria should include how we surface degraded quality to users (e.g. warning banner in Console when model fallback active). Adding a small mock in the doc.
Sophia (ML PM): For quality evals: propose a fixed eval-suite per endpoint: 1) chat PRs (fluency + instruction following), 2) embeddings (cosine/recall on N benchmarks), 3) rerank (MRR + top-1 precision). Define regression thresholds (e.g. <1.5% MRR drop triggers block).
Michael (Eng): +1 on numeric thresholds. Also edge case: mixed-length conversations — the pipeline should use dynamic batching kernels for >1k tokens, otherwise latency will spike. Add an acceptance bullet for memory/KV eviction behavior.
Raj (SRE): rollout gates suggestion: canary at 1% traffic for 2 hours, 5% for 6 hours, then 25% and monitor p95 latency + error rate + quality regression alarms. If any of the three break, auto-roll back. I'll add the exact Prometheus alerts.
Andrea (PM): sounds good. I still need someone to sign off on the rerank acceptance criteria — Sophia can you own that? and Michael please confirm the kernel/kv bullets.
Sophia (ML PM): I can own rerank acceptance. I'll add the eval config and an example eval job: ```python
# eval job pseudo
run_eval(dataset="rerank-open-50k", metric=["MRR","P@1"], threshold={"MRR":0.985})
```
Michael (Eng): I'll confirm kernel + kv behavior and add a short code snippet for batching config in the PRD: ```yaml
batching:
  max_batch_size: 64
  max_latency_ms: 20
  dynamic_kernel_selector: true
```
Raj (SRE): Quick question — do we need a migration plan for existing customers pinned to older model variants? should document opt-in windows and a forced-deprecation policy.
Andrea (PM): yes. Add a deprecation timeline: 90 days notice, opt-in migration tooling, and a hard cut only after enterprise approval.
Eve (Design): I'll mock the admin banner + migration UX for the Console and upload to the doc.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: prd/chat-unified-draft -> canary cluster on 2026-04-02T14:00Z (CI green)
Michael (Eng): noted. I'll queue an infra smoke that runs sample chat + rerank flows against canary.
Sophia (ML PM): final ask: include an explicit prompt-set for regression tests with adversarial prompts for hallucination checks. I added ~120 prompts under /eval/prompt-sets.
Andrea (PM): awesome — I'll revise the PRD with all these bullets and ping for final sign-offs by EOD tomorrow. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
